title: decisions-pack
description: One voted pack of a /review-sheet, ids and verdicts only. No question text, no card HTML, no gloss text, no personal names.

sheet_id.description: Shared with the parent sheet and every sibling pack; never changed except through the A3 migration path.

pack_size.description: Item count this pack was cut to (the last pack of a sheet may hold fewer).

generated.description: DD-MM-YYYY, when the pack HTML was emitted.

decided.description: Count of items in this pack carrying a non-null decision.

reject_label.description: A short reason code when decision is reject; null otherwise.

note.description: Free-text curator note, <=280 chars, no HTML angle brackets, no dump of the card's question field. A pack violating this is refused upstream; the default on ambiguity is to truncate the note and keep the decision.
